description_en: Call this operation to delete a data source that is no longer required
description_zh: 如果已添加的数据源不再使用，可以调用接口删除数据源
kebab_example: aliyun cloud-siem delete-data-source --data-source-instance-id 220ba97c9d1fdb0b9c7e8c7ca328d7ea --account-id 123xxxxxxx --cloud-code hcloud --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2022-06-16 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DeleteDataSource

parameters.help_en: The ID of the data source. This ID is an MD5 hash value calculated by Threat Analysis based on specific parameters. Call the ListDataSourceLogs (https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854\&activeTabKey=api%7CListDataSourceLogs) operation to obtain the data source ID
parameters.help_zh: 数据源ID，由威胁分析根据具体参数计算md5生成。可调用ListDataSourceLogs (https://api.aliyun-inc.com/#/publishment/document/cloud-siem/863fdf54478f4cc5877e27c2a5fe9e44?tenantUuid=f382fccd88b94c5c8c864def6815b854&activeTabKey=api|ListDataSourceLogs)获取数据源ID
parameters.name: data_source_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.name: account_id

parameters.help_en:
The code for the multicloud environment. Valid values:

qcloud: Tencent Cloud.

aliyun: Alibaba Cloud.

hcloud: Huawei Cloud
parameters.help_zh:
多云的code。取值：
qcloud：腾讯云。
aliyun：阿里云。
hcloud：华为云
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management hub of Threat Analysis is located. Select the region of the management hub based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China
parameters.help_zh:
威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：
cn-hangzhou：资产属于中国内地与中国香港
ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
parameters.name: region_id

Data.description_en: The return value of the request

Count.description_en: The number of data sources that are deleted. A value of 1 indicates success. A value of 0 or less indicates failure
Count.description_zh: 删除的数据源的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败
Count.title_zh: 删除的数据源的数量，等于1表示成功，小于等于0表示失败。
